{{Quote|Excellency, the Gama system gives full allegiance to the Empire. The Gama-Senn people accept your will as absolute, my Emperor.|The Gama system's ruler, after witnessing the Galaxy Gun in use|<ref name="EE1" />}}
The '''ruler''' of the [[Gama-Senn]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and their home [[Star system/Legends|system]], the [[Gama system/Legends|Gama system]], swore fealty to [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] after witnessing the power of the [[Galaxy Gun]] in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]].<ref name="EE1" />
